scope: Commits ya consignados para Sprint 2; las fechas se conservan tal como figuran en GitHub y no acreditan ejecución en hardware.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(provisioning): add MycilaESPConnect captive portal + /provision-extra form

Adds src/provisioning.h/.cpp implementing the two-part field-provisioning
flow from Phase 6 (v2.0): MycilaESPConnect's native AP+portal collects
SSID/password only (its Config struct has no other fields), then a custom
/provision-extra HTTP form on the same shared AsyncWebServer collects Edge
API URL and device key once WiFi connects. All four values persist to NVS
via Preferences (namespace "securiot") only after the submitted Edge API
URL passes a reachability ping — an unreachable URL re-serves the retry
form instead of saving or restarting.

setAutoRestart(false) is set explicitly before espConnect.begin(): without
it MycilaESPConnect restarts the device on WiFi connect, before the
operator ever reaches /provision-extra.

Adds indicatePortalActive() to local_alert.h/.cpp: a non-blocking pulsing
blue LED pattern, distinct from the existing solid-blue "connecting" color.

Adds MycilaESPConnect, AsyncTCP and ESPAsyncWebServer (ESP32Async fork,
not the unmaintained me-no-dev original) to platformio.ini lib_deps.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(wifi_manager): read WiFi credentials from Preferences, reopen portal on 3 failed attempts

wifiConnect() no longer reads secrets.h's WIFI_SSID/WIFI_PASSWORD macros.
It calls provisioningBegin() first, then attempts WiFi.begin() with the
stored Preferences credentials up to 3 times (20s timeout each, reusing
the existing kInitialConnectTimeoutMs). If all 3 attempts fail, it reopens
the captive portal (provisioningBegin(force=true), since Preferences still
says "configured" with now-stale credentials) instead of hanging on a dead
connection — the portal blocks the operator can reach and successfully
provision, which restarts the device.

wifiConnect()/wifiEnsureConnected()'s public signatures are unchanged.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(main): source Edge API URL and device key from the provisioning module

main.cpp now reads the Edge API base URL and device key exclusively from
provisioning.h's Preferences-backed getters instead of secrets.h macros or
edge_discovery.cpp's mDNS resolution — DEVICE_ID/ZONE_ID stay hardcoded in
secrets.h, unaffected. loop() calls provisioningLoop() every iteration and
skips capture/send entirely while provisioningActive() is true (AP/portal
phase, or STA-connected-but-awaiting-/provision-extra phase).

secrets.h.example's WiFi/Edge API/device-key fields are now documentation
only, marked [PORTAL-MANAGED] since the firmware no longer reads them at
runtime; DEVICE_ID/ZONE_ID remain real compile-time constants.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
fix(provisioning): keep phone on the AP for the whole flow instead of requiring a manual rejoin

MycilaESPConnect's own loop() tears down the SoftAP (WiFi.softAPdisconnect())
on the very next iteration after WiFi credentials validate (PORTAL_COMPLETE),
even with setAutoRestart(false) — kicking the operator's phone off
SecurIoT-Setup-XXXX before it could ever reach /provision-extra, and forcing
a manual IP hunt after rejoining the real WiFi network.

Fix: stop calling espConnect.loop() the instant PORTAL_COMPLETE fires
(g_espConnectLoopPaused) — the SoftAP and STA connection the library already
opened during credential testing both stay up, since neither AsyncWebServer
nor the DNS server are loop()-driven. /provision-extra is now served at the
SoftAP's fixed gateway IP (4.3.2.1), and "/" redirects there once credentials
validate, ahead of MycilaESPConnect's own "/" handler — so the OS's periodic
captive-portal re-probes (which the library always redirects to "/"
regardless of state) chain straight into /provision-extra automatically,
without the operator's phone ever leaving the AP network.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(07): dispatch manual_command from the /frames response

Adds setManualLight()/setManualBuzzer() as non-coupled, non-blocking
functions (not built on triggerLocalAlert(), which hard-codes red+buzzer
together and blocks for kBuzzerPulseMs). handleFramesResponse() parses the
new manual_command field and dispatches pan_tilt/light/buzzer — the Edge
API already resolved precedence against the same-cycle automatic pan/tilt
tracking delta, firmware only dispatches what it receives. pio run: SUCCESS.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(06.1-01): add protected POST /faces enrollment endpoint

Admin-key gated (X-Admin-Key/EDGE_ADMIN_API_KEY), calls the existing
enroll_identity() unmodified, sanitizes uploaded filenames, and
deletes every temp file/dir on every code path including failures.

D-01, D-02, D-07.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(06.1-02): port capture-quality gates + per-device face-recognition toggle

Task 1: laplacian_variance + validate_capture_quality (ported from the
unmerged feature/yolo-standalone branch) reject blurry/too-small/no-face/
multi-face photos before they reach enroll_identity(); FACE_MINIMUM_
ENROLLMENT_IMAGES stays the single "not enough" threshold (D-03).
Confirmed yolo/ was never merged into develop (D-04).

Task 2: DeviceSetting Peewee model + GET/PATCH /devices/<id>/face-
recognition, admin-key gated, falling back to the global config default
when no per-device override exists.

Task 3: /frames now reads the per-device setting via
get_face_recognition_enabled(device_id) instead of the global config
directly (D-05).

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(07): add manual command queue with TTL and door-action suppression

Adds POST /commands (admin-key gated) with a one-pending-slot-per-actuator
in-memory queue (pan_tilt/light/buzzer), delivered piggybacked on the next
/frames response regardless of detection state, discarded silently after
COMMAND_EXPIRY_SECONDS. A manual pan/tilt command overrides the same-cycle
automatic tracking delta rather than blending with it. Extends the existing
door-action cooldown check to also suppress on manual delivery (CTRL-06),
verified at the unit level per 07-CONTEXT.md D-R2 since the actuator enum
has no public "door" value.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(08): replace hardcoded door_contact_open with configurable rules engine

RULE-05/06/07/08/09/12: new Rule model + REST CRUD (admin-key gated),
evaluation engine wired into /frames (weapon via COCO knife class, fire via
color/brightness heuristic, object_class/occupancy, priority-based
most-restrictive-wins conflict resolution) and /ingest (sensor_threshold
conditions on arbitrary readings, shared dispatch path with frames.py).
Migrates the old hardcoded person/backpack door-lock check into two
equivalent seeded rules on first boot (RULE-12), removing the duplicated
logic. 71/71 tests passing.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(06.1-01): proxy face enrollment to a device's Edge API

Adds Device.edgeUrl (operator-configurable via PATCH /devices/:id,
rejecting loopback/link-local hosts), and POST /devices/:id/faces
which proxies to the device's edge-api with X-Admin-Key and mirrors
its response, remapping a raw Edge 401 to Cloud 502.

D-06, D-07.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(06.1-03): proxy the per-device face-recognition toggle to Edge

GET/PATCH /api/v1/devices/:id/face-recognition, IDOR-safe (findOneForOwner
before any Edge call), targeting the GET/PATCH /devices/<id>/face-
recognition contract app/device_settings.py exposes on the edge-api.

Refactors the Edge-proxy request/401-remap logic shared with enrollFace
(06.1-01) into one callDeviceEdgeApi() helper, now used by all three
Cloud->Edge proxy call sites.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(07): add POST /devices/:id/commands proxy to Edge

Same JWT-guarded ownership-checked proxy pattern as the Phase 06.1
face-recognition endpoints, reusing callDeviceEdgeApi() unmodified
(including its 401->502 remap). Validates actuator against
pan_tilt/light/buzzer before ever contacting Edge.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(08): retire hardcoded door_contact_open Alert logic, add device offline alert

RULE-12: AlertsService.evaluateRule() no longer hardcodes a door_contact/open
check — it now turns any Edge-relayed "rule_alert" Reading (from the new
Edge rules engine) into an Alert generically, no duplicated rule logic on
this side. Updated e2e coverage accordingly.

EXTR-01: new DeviceOfflineCheckService (@nestjs/schedule, checks every
minute) creates a device_offline Alert when a device's last reading falls
outside DEVICE_ONLINE_WINDOW_SECONDS, and auto-resolves it once the device
reports again. 5 unit + 44 e2e tests passing, build clean.

commits.author: Sve-nnN
commits.message:
feat(06.1-04): Web UI for device edge URL, face enrollment, and toggle

New DeviceFaceRecognitionComponent at /devices/:id/face-recognition,
reachable from the devices list: configure the device's edgeUrl,
register a face (multi-photo upload + name, showing accepted/skipped
counts and per-photo skip reasons), and toggle face recognition on/off
— all through the Cloud proxy endpoints only (D-06), never the device's
edge-api directly.

A11Y: native labeled file input, no color-only toggle state (adjacent
text), aria-live status/alert regions, visible focus, no [innerHTML] on
backend-supplied strings (T-06.1-12).

New i18n keys in both en-US and es-419 (neutral Spanish, tuteo).

team_post_sprint2_commits.message:
fix(firmware): move camera XCLK to LEDC timer 3 so servos stop killing the camera

The servos allocated LEDC timer 0 and retuned it to 50 Hz, the same timer the
camera used for its 20 MHz XCLK, so captures failed once the servos moved.
